topics.topic: Which content hash PhotoPlacement records
questions: Is `the hash` the SHA-256 source_id of the original content, a hash of the prepared stored image, or an additional field containing one of each?

quotes:
The record that one source photo of one project was placed in the Portal binary store. It
carries the `project_id`, the `source_id`, the source name, the `file_ref`, the hash, size and
media type of the stored image, how the photo date was obtained and the publication body (M05).
- Minted by: the deliverer, from `project_id` and `source_id`, the SHA-256 of the source content.
judgement.why: The text distinguishes source_id as the SHA-256 of source content from the separate hash associated with the stored image.
